page: Google Cloud Platform a3-ultragpu-8g-nolssd is an accelerator-optimized server designed for high-end parallel computing and machine learning. It features 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs from the Hopper architecture, delivering a total of 1128 GB of VRAM. The host system is powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor with 224 vCPUs (112 physical cores) running at 2.1 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The system includes 2952.0 GB of system memory, providing 13.18 GB of RAM per core. This configuration does not include local SSD storage.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, scoring 180184.5 in stress-ng and 125594.41 in Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, reaching 13946.39 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 431.26 GB/sec for large block reads. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), contribute to top-tier performance in software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing. Database operations are also highly efficient, with Redis SET operations achieving 221.56 million operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of this instance type is the complete absence of local SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of H200 GPUs and massive system memory represents a premium hardware tier optimized for resource-intensive workloads rather than general-purpose computing. It is highly suited for large-scale AI and machine learning workloads, including LLM training and inference, complex physical simulations, and high-throughput data processing.
